# 八角录屏 (anise-recorder)

> Local-first macOS screen recorder & demo editor. 录屏、剪辑、导出全部在
> 本机完成：无账号、无上传、无遥测、零第三方运行时依赖。

八角录屏 (anise-recorder) 是一个原生 macOS 应用，使用 SwiftUI 与
ScreenCaptureKit 构建。它把屏幕、系统声音、麦克风和摄像头**分别**录制为
独立文件，再在五轨时间线上完成剪辑（点击放大、摄像头构图、智能精剪、
字幕、打码、素材叠加），最后导出 MP4 / GIF / SRT。工程数据只保存在
`~/Movies/八角录屏/`。

## Key facts / 关键事实

- Platform: macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon), SwiftUI + ScreenCaptureKit + AVFoundation
- Language: Swift 6 toolchain, SwiftPM only (no .xcodeproj, no third-party packages)
- Build: `swift build` · Test: `swift test` (long-export suite gated by env `ANISE_RECORDER_LONG_EXPORT=1`)
- Package app: `./scripts/build_app.sh` → `八角录屏.app`
- Data: projects in `~/Movies/八角录屏/`, schemaVersion 5, `project.json` per project
- Privacy: zero network code; on-device speech recognition only
  (`requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true`); fails explicitly instead of cloud fallback
- Coordinates: normalized capture/click/camera regions use top-left origin,
  y-down; AppKit & Core Image are bottom-left, y-up — see Architecture doc
- Compatibility identifiers kept intentionally (bundle id `com.localstudio.recorder`,
  legacy folder "Local Studio", `.localstudio-hidden` marker, `LocalStudio.*`
  UserDefaults keys) — do not rename them; they are annotated in code
- License: Apache-2.0 · Language of UI & docs: Simplified Chinese (+ English README)
